reel.purpose: Digits in the backglass score reels.

label.purpose: Buttons, segmented controls and backglass readouts.

shadows.name: print-offset
shadows.value: hard navy offset 0.4 by 0.6 table units
shadows.purpose: The printed shadow under bumpers, rails, flippers and the ball.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: A button inverting to ink when pressed.

components.name: Button
components.description: Paper button with an ink border and condensed lettering; inverts when pressed, hatched when disabled.
components.css: .ds-btn { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 18px; border: 2px solid #1d2340; border-radius: 4px; background: #efe6d2; color: #1d2340; font: 700 17px Bahnschrift, 'Roboto Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-stretch: condensed; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #f7f0e1; } .ds-btn:active:not(:disabled) { background: #1d2340; color: #efe6d2; transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e4472f; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn:disabled { color: #857f70; border-color: #cbbd9c; background: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(29,35,64,.08) 0 1px, transparent 1px 5px), #e4d8bd; cursor: default; }

components.name: Go Button
components.description: The one primary action per page.
components.css: .ds-go { min-height: 54px; padding: 0 30px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: #c7361f; color: #fff; font: 700 21px Bahnschrift, 'Roboto Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-stretch: condensed; cursor: pointer; } .ds-go:hover { background: #b32f1a; } .ds-go:active { background: #8f2514; } .ds-go:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e4472f; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Score Reels
components.description: Eight reel windows; unused leading windows stay dark.
components.css: .ds-reels { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; padding: 6px; background: #141a33; } .ds-reels i, .ds-reels b { width: 30px; height: 44px; display: grid; place-items: center; } .ds-reels i { background: #262c46; } .ds-reels b { background: #efe6d2; color: #1d2340; font: 800 34px Bahnschrift, 'Roboto Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-stretch: condensed; }

components.name: Mission Row
components.description: A mission with its star, filled in the table's second ink once earned.
components.html: Lock two balls and start multiball.
components.css: .ds-m { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 22px 1fr; gap: 8px; align-items: center; font: 14px 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #1d2340; background: #efe6d2; padding: 8px; width: 320px; }

narrative.overview: Pinball Almanac is a screen-printed pinball flyer that plays: navy ground, two inks per table in halftone and slightly off register, with electro-mechanical score reels that chime as they count.
keyCharacteristics: Two inks per table on navy
Score reels, not a dot matrix

rules.name: Two inks a table
rules.body: No table adds a third saturated colour.

rules.name: Lamps are designed unlit
rules.body: An unlit insert is its ink mixed toward navy; lit is the full ink. Nothing glows.

rules.name: Print, not chrome
rules.body: Depth is a hard printed offset; the ball is the only chrome.

dos: Print in two inks on navy
Show every lamp unlit as well as lit
Keep the backglass to four readouts
donts: No third ink on a table
